cases.title: BROKEN VARIANT of N40: natural order switched off, so P1A, P1B, P9A and P10A drop below P10 in text order and SPS10 sorts above SPS2 (must FAIL)
cases.plan_item: red-before-green proof for N40 (UX-SCHED-06, daily card D21 assertions 2 and 4)
cases.expected: This variant is wrong on purpose: with the switch off CE lists P1 to P10 by number, then C1, P10A, P1A, P1B, P9A, SPS10, SPS2, so the whole-chain check and the P10A/P1A, P10/P9A and SPS10/SPS2 checks fail. The placement checks, the six presence checks and the P10/P2 and P10A/P9 checks pass.
cases.why_not_unit: It exists only to prove N40's order checks go red when the switch is off.
